BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: VII
BRANCH: CIVIL   SESSION : MO/2019

                                                 SUBJECT : CE7013 DISASTER MANAGEMENT

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) What is Cyclogenesis? [2]
 (b) Write short notes on Tsunami. [3]


Q2 (a) Define Disaster and Risk. [2]
 (b) What are the 3 nodal centers of disaster management in India and explain their functions. [3]


Q3 (a) What are the components of a Disaster management Plan? [2]
 (b) Write your observations on cyclone mitigation initiatives and techniques in India. [3]


Q4 (a) What should be the role NIDM in Disaster management? Which national level policy has
been framed to monitor and mitigate disasters in India?
[2]
 (b) What are the parameters and criteria’s for identifying cumulative Hazard? Discuss each
criteria without scores.
[3]


Q5 (a) Compare Rehabilitation and Reconstruction using examples. [2]
 (b) What are the roles of FAO and RED Cross in managing disasters? [3]


Q6 (a) Justify the functions of Media in Disaster Management. [2]
 (b) Prepare a Disaster management Plan for a city having a population of 300000 with 50%
aging population, and 20% below the age of 16. Assume that it is affected by Tsunami.
Justify your answer using assumptions.
[3]

Q1 (a) What is a hazard? What is the difference between hazard and disaster? [2]
 (b) What is disaster management? Why do we need disaster management? [3]


Q2 (a) Discuss the phases of Disaster Management Cycle. [2]
 (b) Discuss the significance of disaster prevention and highlight major issues involved in it. [3]


Q3 (a) Define Risk Assessment and underline the methodologies for conducting risk assessment. [2]
 (b) Explain the role of government agencies for Disaster Management. [3]


Q4 (a) How climate change affect the occurrences of natural disasters? [2]
 (b) Discuss the concept of community based Disaster Management and highlight its principles
and challenges.
[3]


Q5 (a) Write a note on capacity building for Earthquake Vulnerability Reduction. [2]
 (b) What  is  a  soft-storey?  Describe  the  seismic  response  of  a  reinforced  concrete  framed
building with a soft-storey?
[3]


Q6 (a) Explain the mitigation measures required for Earthquakes. [2]
 (b) Explain the design procedure for disaster resistant construction. [3]
